name: Fairy Doctor
text: Tithe. Lamp. While she stands, your bank yields +1. Adjacent units you control strike for +1 Power. A country doctor of the sidhe. She diagnoses the fairy stroke and invoices the hedge.
quote: The cure is milk, iron, and a name said backwards.

name: Bean-Nighe
text: Ranged Strike. Gills. The washer at the ford. Her keen reaches 2 circles in a straight line, never the diagonal, and is not answered.
quote: If you see her beating a shirt, ask whose.

name: The Pooka
text: Fast Attack. Untargetable. Strikes first. Strikes and rites pass over him. A black horse-man of the Irish road who will not be named.
quote: Take the ride. You will not choose where it ends.

name: Swan Maiden
text: Fast Attack. Relay. Strikes first. When you muster another unit, draw 1. She left the feather-skin on the bank. Whoever holds it holds the next plate.
quote: Do not hide the skin. She will find the house.

name: Clurichaun
text: Greater Tithe. Hearth. Your bank yields +2 while he stands, and a resource he stands on banks twice. The cellar fairy who guards the cask and charges rent.
quote: He is loyal to the wine, not to you.

name: The Fetch
text: Fast Attack. If it survives a battle it struck in, it gains power. Your double, arrived early. It strikes first, and living makes the copy heavier.
quote: If you meet it at noon, sit down.

name: Brownie of the Stair
text: Hearth. Tithe. A resource it stands on banks twice, and your bank yields +1. The small person of the stair who works the night and leaves when you offer a wage.
quote: A bowl of cream. Never a coin.

name: Selkie Coat
text: Gills. Toughness. The first point of any blow is refused. The skin is the person. Fold it and the sea cannot take them. Unfold it and they are gone.
quote: Lock the chest. Lose the marriage.

name: Fear Gortach
text: Root. Toughness. The hunger grass. Enemy plates beside it cannot move or strike, and the first point of any blow is refused. Step on it and you are held until you are eaten by standing still.
quote: The field looks ordinary. That is the trap.

name: The Merrow
text: Gills. Seep. At the start of your rite, deal 1 to each adjacent enemy. The mermaid of the Irish coast, red cap, green hair, a net of names.
quote: She keeps the drowned in a pocket of the sea.

name: The Sluagh
text: Cryptid. Fast Attack. Ranged Strike. The host of the unforgiven dead, flying west to east. It strikes first. The shot is a straight line and is not answered.
quote: Shut the west window. They come from that side.

name: Night-Mare of the Barrow
text: Cryptid. Untargetable. The pressing spirit of the mound. Strikes and rites pass over it. You wake with the weight and no one to blame.
quote: It sits on the chest. It does not sit on the list.

name: Whitethorn Bind
text: Name a unit. It cannot move or attack on its next rite. A whitethorn tied on the named plate. The hedge holds the appointment.
quote: The bush is the lock.

name: Send Them Home
text: Name a unit and return it to the hand it came from. The good people are finished with the guest.
quote: The door is the way you came.

name: Iron in the Milk
text: Name a unit. Deal 2 damage. A nail dropped in the pan. The fairy thing drinks and remembers it is not welcome.
quote: Hospitality has a mineral.

name: The Good People's Cup
text: Device. Bank 1 resources and draw 1 card. Leave it on the step. Something drinks, and a plate is paid back.
quote: Never watch them drink it.

name: The May Queen
text: Leader. Once in a sitting: pay 3. Name a unit you own. It gains Fast Attack and may act at once. The queen of the hawthorn puts the green on someone and they move before the hour does.
quote: I am not a parish. I am the month the hedge is dangerous.

name: Aether Diver
text: Greater Tithe. While the suit is on the circle, your bank yields +2. An interwar diver of the luminiferous aether. The helmet should not work. The patent says it does.
quote: He came back with frost on the inside of the glass.

name: Chromium Surgeon
text: Fast Attack. If it survives a battle it struck in, it gains power. A mad anatomist in a mirror-bright apron. Strikes first. The operation that lives becomes the next instrument.
quote: He does not sew. He upgrades.

name: Night-Scope
text: Ranged Strike. Shutter. A shot reaches 2 circles in a straight line, never the diagonal, and is not answered. Ranged strikes cannot choose this plate. An occult optic that sees the decade after this one.
quote: The reticule is not aimed at anything you can name.

name: Walking Dynamo
text: Slow Attack. Toughness. Lamp. It strikes last. The first point of any blow is refused. Adjacent units you control strike for +1 Power. A dynamo that stood up and went to work.
quote: The floor hums when it clocks in.

name: Ozone Lieutenant
text: Fast Attack. Lamp. Strikes first. Adjacent units you control strike for +1 Power. She smells of lightning and filing cabinets. The bureau gave her a rank the army does not have.
quote: Breathe after she passes. Not during.

name: Phosphor Clerk
text: Relay. Tithe. When you muster another unit, draw 1. Your bank yields +1 while he stands. His cuffs glow. The ledger glows. He does not notice.
quote: He files the living under Miscellaneous.

name: Gyro Priest
text: Toughness. Shutter. The first point of any blow is refused. Ranged strikes cannot choose him. A chaplain of the spinning compass. His vestments are ball bearings and black wool.
quote: The sermon is a rate of turn.

name: X-Ray Confessor
text: Ranged Strike. The confession is a straight exposure, 2 circles, never the diagonal, and it is not answered. He sees the bone and the secret in the same plate.
quote: Hold still. The sin develops in the darkroom.

name: The Patent Golem
text: Slow Attack. Toughness. It strikes last. The first point of any blow is refused. A golem filed at the bureau in 1927, stamped, witnessed, and wound with copper instead of a shem.
quote: The name on its forehead is a registration number.

name: Broadcast Spire
text: Relay. Lamp. When you muster another unit, draw 1. Adjacent units you control strike for +1 Power. A tower that repeats your muster to the whole yard.
quote: It does not play music. It plays orders.

name: The Unlicensed Engine
text: Cryptid. Greater Tithe. Toughness. A machine the bureau never approved. Your bank yields +2. The first point of any blow is refused. It runs anyway.
quote: There is no plate on the boiler. There is a pulse.

name: The Glass Lung
text: Cryptid. Ranged Strike. Shutter. A medical engine that learned to aim. The shot is a straight line and is not answered. Ranged strikes cannot choose it.
quote: It breathes for whoever is inside. Then it chooses.

name: Discharge
text: Name a unit. Deal 3 damage. The bureau throws the helix past the red line. The named plate takes the whole arc.
quote: The meter melts. That is the receipt.

name: Filed Silence
text: Name a unit. It cannot move or attack on its next rite. A docket of quiet. The plate is pending and may not act.
quote: Stamped. Held. Not destroyed.

name: Melt the Barrels
text: Deal 2 damage to every enemy unit with Ranged Strike. The bureau buys the guns as scrap and pours them the same afternoon.
quote: Ordnance is an ore.

name: Spare Helix
text: Device. Bank 1 resources and draw 1 card. One coil left in the cage, still warm from a test that was not logged.
quote: Do not touch both ends.

name: Chief Adler
text: Leader. Once in a sitting: pay 2. Name a unit. It gains Shutter and Toughness. The chief of the bureau puts a patent on a body. Ranged strikes cannot choose it, and the first point of any blow is refused.
quote: I do not invent the future. I license it.

name: Salt Magister
text: Greater Tithe. While he stands, your bank yields +2. Master of the salt that fixes a spirit in the flesh. The college pays him in resources and he pays them in what remains of the soul.
quote: Nothing volatile survives his office.

name: The Living Monad
text: Slow Attack. Toughness. It strikes last. The first point of any blow is refused. A soul that acquired weight and will not settle until both sides have moved.
quote: You may turn away. The one remains.

name: Fellow of the Veil
text: Fast Attack. Strikes first. A junior who sends his subtle body ahead of his flesh. If the blow kills, it is not answered.
quote: The shade arrives before the man.

name: Athanor Keeper
text: Hearth. Toughness. A resource he stands on banks twice. The first point of any blow is refused. He keeps the furnace that never goes out. The faculty is a temperature.
quote: Do not open the door to see if it is done.

name: Novice of the Veil
text: Slow muster. Relay. It cannot move or attack the rite it arrives. When you muster another unit, draw 1. A student still learning to see with the inner eye.
quote: The first night is the slow one.

name: The Golden Visage
text: Lamp. Tithe. Adjacent units you control strike for +1 Power. Your bank yields +1. A small sun that makes every neighboring soul hit harder.
quote: Behold it. The rest follows.

name: Flask Archivist
text: Relay. When you muster another unit, draw 1. She keeps the homunculi in labeled glass and already knows which plate you meant to draw.
quote: The catalogue is alive. She pretends it is not.

name: The Fixed Star
text: Ranged Strike. Shutter. A shot of cold light, 2 circles, straight, never the diagonal, unanswered. Ranged strikes cannot choose it. An astronomer who nailed a star to the yard.
quote: It does not wander. Neither does the wound.

name: Saint of the Inner Light
text: Lamp. If it is still standing at the end of its rite, it gains 1 power. Adjacent units you control strike for +1 Power. A saint of the inward fire. Every rite it survives, the light climbs.
quote: Flame, not reckoning.

name: The Unsaid Name
text: Fast Attack. If it survives a battle it struck in, it gains power. The name the college would not speak. It strikes first, and the unsaid part grows teeth.
quote: Leave the last name unsaid. It will finish itself.

name: The Closed Eye
text: Cryptid. Untargetable. Lamp. A face the college forbids novices to look at. Strikes pass over it. Adjacent units you control strike for +1 Power.
quote: Shut your eyes. It is still there.

name: The Fifth Presence
text: Cryptid. Toughness. Shutter. A presence that should not have a body. The first point of any blow is refused. Ranged strikes cannot choose it.
quote: Do not name it. It is already here.

name: Strike the Name
text: Name a unit and return it to the hand it came from. The name is withdrawn. The plate goes back unsaid.
quote: Unsay it. Do not burn it.

name: Two Unveilings
text: Draw 2 cards. Two visions, already finished, laid in the hand.
quote: The long way was vanity.

name: Aqua Fortis
text: Name a unit. Deal 2 damage. Strong water of the retort. The faculty calls it a reagent. The plate calls it a hole.
quote: Nitrate. Then silence.

name: Faculty Advance
text: Device. Bank 1 resources and draw 1 card. The college advances a coin and a plate against a working you have not opened.
quote: The debt comes due in the next rite.

name: Rector of the Monad
text: Leader. Once in a sitting: pay 2. Name a unit you own. It gains +1 power, and you draw a card. The rector lays a word on a living body and keeps the vision.
quote: We do not pray. We behold.

name: The Mad Hieromonk
text: Fast Attack. Toughness. Strikes first. The first point of any blow is refused. A monk of the lavra who left the rule and kept the shoulders. He hits before the troparion ends.
quote: The cowl is torn. The arm is not.

name: Ovinnik
text: Hearth. Tithe. A resource it stands on banks twice, and your bank yields +1. The barn spirit. Black as a kiln. Leave the first sheaf or it burns the second.
quote: The threshing floor has a landlord.

name: Nochnitsa
text: Untargetable. The night-hag of the cradle. Strikes and rites pass over her. She cannot be named. You hear the breath. You do not get a target.
quote: She sits where the child was going to sleep.

name: Gamayun
text: Ranged Strike. Lamp. The prophetic bird of the Slavic east, a woman-face and a wingspan of omen. The cry reaches 2 circles in a straight line and is not answered. Adjacent units you control strike for +1 Power.
quote: She speaks the future. The future is a wound.

name: Likho
text: Fast Attack. If it survives a battle it struck in, it gains power. One-eyed misfortune. It strikes first, and if it lives the bad luck gets larger.
quote: Do not look it in the only eye.

name: The Skomorokh
text: Fast Attack. Relay. Strikes first. When you muster another unit, draw 1. A holy-fool minstrel the church threw out and the village kept. His song is a muster list.
quote: Laugh. Then draw.

name: Kupala Flame
text: Lamp. If it is still standing at the end of its rite, it gains 1 power. Adjacent units you control strike for +1 Power. The midsummer fire that the shaman will not let go out.
quote: Jump it if you are brave. Feed it if you are wise.

name: Dvorovoi
text: Hearth. Toughness. A resource it stands on banks twice. The first point of any blow is refused. The yard spirit, grudging, hairy, loyal to the gate and not to guests.
quote: He knows which chicken is yours.

name: The Black Monk
text: Slow Attack. Toughness. He strikes last. The first point of any blow is refused. A starets who painted himself into the dark of an icon and then stepped out of it, late.
quote: He arrives after you have spent your breath.

name: Alkonost
text: Greater Tithe. The bird whose song makes a man forget his labor. While she sings, your bank yields +2. The work gets done by somebody who was not listening.
quote: Cover your ears if you still want the wage.

name: The Pike Tsar
text: Cryptid. Gills. Seep. The great pike under the mill. At the start of your rite, deal 1 to each adjacent enemy. A shaman bargained with it. The bargain is still swimming.
quote: By the pike, by my wish. Then pay.

name: The Grave Candle
text: Cryptid. Untargetable. A light on a Slavic grave that cannot be named or shot. Strikes pass over it. Follow it and you are in the wrong yard.
quote: It is not a soul. It is a bill.

name: Bark Knot
text: Name a unit. It cannot move or attack on its next rite. A shaman ties white bark around a name. The plate stands in the grove.
quote: Three strips. One road, closed.

name: Break the Face
text: Name a unit. Deal 3 damage. The mad monk breaks an icon across a plate. The gold leaf cuts.
quote: Even a saint can be swung.

name: Out of the House
text: Name a unit and return it to the hand it came from. The dvorovoi wants the guest off the yard before the stove cools.
quote: Boots by the door. You are done.

name: Coals of the Stove
text: Device. Bank 1 resources and draw 1 card. The stove pays a coal and deals a plate. The hut keeps its oath.
quote: Sit on the warm side.

name: Father of the Last Icon
text: Leader. Once in a sitting: pay 3. Name a unit you own. It gains +3 power. The mad monk nails the last icon to a living chest and calls it armor.
quote: Pray after. First, do not die.

name: Cailleach of the Thorn
text: Toughness. Lamp. The first point of any blow is refused. Adjacent units you control strike for +1 Power. She is the winter witch of the hedge, not a court magician. The thorn beside her hits harder.
quote: The hill goes white when she stands up.

name: Sidhe Knight
text: Fast Attack. Strikes first. A rider out of the hollow hill. If the blow kills, it is not answered.
quote: He does not duel. He arrives.

name: Puck of the Gate
text: Untargetable. Strikes and rites pass over him. He cannot be named. The gate laughs and is not there to be hit.
quote: Call him and you are calling a hedge.

name: Leanan of the Well
text: Greater Tithe. While she stands, your bank yields +2. The muse of the well does not sing for free. She invoices in hawthorn.
quote: Drink, and pay the green.

name: Kelpie of the Ford
text: Fast Attack. Gills. Strikes first. The horse in the ford is a fairy law, not a spell with a hat.
quote: The bridle is wet. The rider is not coming back the same.

name: The Dullahan
text: Slow Attack. Toughness. He strikes last, and the first point of any blow is refused. The headless rider of the Irish road. His whip is a spine.
quote: He holds his own face up like a lantern.

name: Changeling Cradle
text: Relay. When you muster another unit, draw 1. The cradle at the door has the wrong child in it, and the wrong child knows your next plate.
quote: They left a song where the baby was.

name: Redcap
text: Fast Attack. If it survives a battle it struck in, it gains power. A border goblin in a dyed cap. It strikes first, and living makes it worse.
quote: The cap stays red. He sees to that.

name: The Green Man
text: Toughness. Hearth. If he is still standing at the end of its rite, he gains 1 power. A resource he stands on banks twice. The face in the oak is a parish, not a wizard.
quote: Leaves in the mouth. Rent in the roots.

name: Banshee of the Barrow
text: Ranged Strike. The keen reaches 2 circles in a straight line, never the diagonal, and is not answered. She does not duel. She names the death from the mound.
quote: Someone in the house has already heard her.

name: The Each-Uisge
text: Cryptid. Fast Attack. Gills. The water-horse of the Highlands. It strikes first, and the ford does not give the body back.
quote: Do not mount what came out of the loch wearing a smile.

name: Will of the Marsh
text: Cryptid. Untargetable. A light on the bog that cannot be named or shot. Strikes pass over it. Follow it and you are off the path.
quote: The lamp is not yours. The path is not a path.

name: Hawthorn Lock
text: Name a unit. It cannot move or attack on its next rite. A whitethorn sprig on the door. The named plate waits in the hedge.
quote: Iron is rude. Thorn is law.

name: The Wild Courtesy
text: Name a unit and return it to its owner’s hand. The sidhe are polite. They send the guest home before the meal.
quote: You were never invited to stay.

name: Milk and Iron
text: Name a unit. Deal 2 damage. Milk for the house. Iron for the thing that should not have crossed the stile.
quote: One for the cow. One for the nail.

name: Rowan Nail
text: Device. Bank 1 resources and draw 1 card. A rowan peg in the lintel. The house pays, and a plate comes to the hand.
quote: Hang it where the good people knock.

name: The Whitethorn Queen
text: Leader. Once in a sitting: pay 2. Name a unit you own. It stands back up and gains +1 power. The queen of the hedge puts her own back on their feet.
quote: I do not curse. I grow the door shut behind you.

name: Coil Saint
text: Lamp. Ranged Strike. Adjacent units you control strike for +1 Power. The shot is a straight line of coiled light, two circles, never the diagonal, and it is not answered. An interwar saint of the transformer yard.
quote: She blesses the grid. The grid answers in white.

name: Gas-Mask Chemist
text: Tithe. Shutter. While he stands, your bank yields +1. Ranged strikes cannot choose him. The mask is a patent. The fog is a product.
quote: Do not ask what the canister was for.

name: Cathode Acolyte
text: Fast Attack. Relay. Strikes first. When you muster another unit, draw 1. A boy in a workshop apron who learned the tube before he learned the prayer.
quote: The glass glows. He glows with it.

name: Ray Rifleman
text: Ranged Strike. A patent rifle. The shot reaches 2 circles in a straight line, never the diagonal, and is not answered. Interwar infantry for a war that has not been declared.
quote: He does not aim at a man. He aims at a frequency.

name: Brass Automaton
text: Slow Attack. Toughness. It strikes last. The first point of any blow is refused. A walking lathe from a works that should not have the decade yet.
quote: It does not tire. It does not enlist. It clocks in.

name: The Patent Airship
text: Greater Tithe. While it hangs over the circle, your bank yields +2. A black envelope with a laboratory in the gondola. The patent is older than the sky it flies in.
quote: They filed the clouds in 1924.

name: Diagram Clerk
text: Fast Attack. If it survives a battle it struck in, it gains power. The clerk opens the living like a schematic. Strikes first. Coming back from the cut makes the next cut worse.
quote: Label the nerve. Then use it.

name: Difference Engine
text: Slow muster. Hearth. It cannot move or attack the rite it arrives. A resource it stands on banks twice. The machine is doing a sum the faculty is not allowed to see.
quote: It clicks when a man would have prayed.

name: Radium Sister
text: Toughness. Lamp. The first point of any blow is refused. Adjacent units you control strike for +1 Power. She paints the dials. The dials paint her hands. Everyone beside her hits brighter.
quote: The glow does not wash off.

name: Trench Radio
text: Relay. Shutter. When you muster another unit, draw 1. Ranged strikes cannot choose it. A set that should be a decade away, already taking orders from the mud.
quote: The voice in the headset is not on your side of the year.

name: The Walking Lamp
text: Cryptid. Lamp. Ranged Strike. A lamp that grew legs in the works. Adjacent units you control strike for +1. The shot is a straight line and is not answered.
quote: Do not follow the light into the yard after whistle.

name: Null Tank
text: Cryptid. Toughness. Shutter. The first point of any blow is refused. Ranged strikes cannot choose it. An armored saint with no crew and no decade it belongs to.
quote: The hatch does not open from this side of the war.

name: Overload
text: Name a unit. Deal 3 damage. The works throws the switch past the red line. The named plate takes the whole discharge.
quote: The meter does not have a number for this.

name: Blackout Patent
text: Name a unit. It cannot move or attack on its next rite. A filed darkness. The plate is off the grid until the next rite.
quote: We own the hour the lights go out.

name: Scrap the Line
text: Deal 2 damage to every enemy unit with Ranged Strike. The works buys their barrels and melts them in the same shift.
quote: Guns are a raw material.

name: Spare Cathode
text: Device. Bank 1 resources and draw 1 card. One tube left in the drawer, already warm.
quote: Do not drop it. It knows your name.

name: Director Voss
text: Leader. Once in a sitting: pay 3. Name a unit you own. It gains Fast Attack and may act at once. She throws the switch on a living body and the body clocks in early.
quote: The future is a patent. I hold the paper.

name: Seer of the Threshold
text: Lamp. Adjacent units you control strike for +1 Power. She sees the blow in the dark before it is thrown. The next plate beside her hits on her seeing.
quote: The veil was here before the room.

name: Quicksilver Fellow
text: Fast Attack. Strikes first. A junior of the retort who moves like the metal he keeps in his teeth. If the blow kills, it is not answered.
quote: He does not sit for the portrait. The portrait has to catch him.

name: Homunculus Clerk
text: Relay. When you muster another unit, draw 1. A little man grown in a flask to file the faculty’s letters. He already knows the next plate.
quote: He signs in a hand smaller than the law.

name: Vitriol Reader
text: Ranged Strike. Shutter. A shot of green glass reaches 2 circles in a straight line, never the diagonal, and is not answered. Ranged strikes cannot choose her. She reads the burn the way other people read a page.
quote: The stain on the cuff is a citation.

name: The Risen Adept
text: Slow Attack. Toughness. It strikes last. The first point of any blow is refused. A presence that stood up out of the body and will not sit until the work is done.
quote: You may refuse. It has already arrived.

name: Azoth Lecturer
text: Greater Tithe. While he stands, your bank yields +2. He teaches the solvent that opens a soul. The tuition is paid in resources.
quote: The vessel drinks the fire and wants more.

name: Cabalist of the Soul
text: Tithe. Lamp. Your bank yields +1 while she stands. Adjacent units you control strike for +1 Power. A master of the living soul. What stands beside her strikes harder.
quote: She does not measure. She consecrates.

name: Retort Warden
text: Toughness. Hearth. The first point of any blow is refused. A resource he stands on banks twice. He keeps the furnace and the furnace keeps the faculty.
quote: No one opens the vessel while he is watching the color.

name: The Waxed Spark
text: Slow muster. It cannot move or attack the rite it arrives. If it is still standing at the end of its rite, it gains 1 power. A sealed spark that learns a body.
quote: Do not break the seal on the first night. Let it quicken.

name: The Hidden Adept
text: Fast Attack. If it survives a battle it struck in, it gains power. A name struck from the book that stood up anyway. It strikes first, and what it does not end is taken into the dark.
quote: What is hidden does not leave.

name: The Forbidden Presence
text: Cryptid. Toughness. Shutter. A presence the college forbids and the laboratory kept anyway. The first point is refused. Ranged strikes cannot choose it.
quote: It stands where no body should stand.

name: The Veiled Presence
text: Cryptid. Fast Attack. Lamp. It strikes first. Adjacent units you control strike for +1 Power. The veil has a body under it, and a following.
quote: Do not speak its name. Walk behind it.

name: Recall the Name
text: Name a unit and return it to its owner’s hand. The name does not belong in this working. Send it back unsaid.
quote: Take it off the tongue. Not out of the world.

name: The Brief Unveiling
text: Draw 2 cards. Two visions, already finished, laid in the hand.
quote: The long way was vanity.

name: Vitriol
text: Name a unit. Deal 2 damage. Green oil of the retort. The faculty calls it a reagent. The plate calls it a wound.
quote: Visit the interior of the earth. Rectify.

name: Loan of the Faculty
text: Device. Bank 1 resources and draw 1 card. The college advances you a plate and a coin against a working you have not yet opened.
quote: The debt is due in the next rite.

name: Provost of the Azoth
text: Leader. Once in a sitting: pay 2. Name a unit you own. It gains +1 power, and you draw a card. The provost lays a hand on a living body and takes the vision that follows.
quote: We do not believe. We behold.

name: Volkhv of the Birches
text: Lamp. Tithe. Adjacent units you control strike for +1 Power. While he stands, your bank yields +1. A grizzled shaman of the white trees. He does not wear a wizard’s hat. He wears bark and a knife.
quote: He speaks to the grove. The grove answers in rent.

name: Leshy
text: Toughness. Root. The first point of any blow is refused. Enemy plates beside him cannot move or strike. The master of the forest. One shoe, one height, and the path belongs to him.
quote: You were tall when you entered. You will not leave tall.

name: Rusalka
text: Gills. Seep. At the start of your rite, deal 1 to each adjacent enemy. The drowned girl in the willow. The river is her parish.
quote: She combs her hair with a bone and the bank listens.

name: Domovoi
text: Hearth. Tithe. A resource he stands on banks twice, and your bank yields +1 besides. The grandfather behind the stove. Leave him bread or he hides the matches.
quote: The house is a body. He is the cough.

name: Bannik
text: Shutter. Toughness. Ranged strikes cannot choose him. The first point of any blow is refused. The spirit of the bathhouse, naked, sooty, and older than the soap.
quote: Do not bathe third. The third turn is his.

name: Firebird
text: Fast Attack. If it survives a battle it struck in, it gains power. The bird of the Slavic tale. It strikes first, and a feather left in the ash is a promotion.
quote: Catch it and the tsar’s garden burns happier.

name: Bogatyr Monk
text: Fast Attack. Toughness. Strikes first. The first point of any blow is refused. A mad monk built like a gate. He hits before the prayer is finished.
quote: The cowl does not make him small.

name: Kikimora
text: Untargetable. Strikes and rites pass over her. She cannot be named. The woman who spins in the cellar at the wrong hour. You hear the wheel. You do not get to point at it.
quote: If the thread is wet, she is already in the house.

name: Polevik
text: Hearth. If he is still standing at the end of its rite, he gains 1 power. A resource he stands on banks twice. The field spirit, black as noon-soil, who counts the sheaves.
quote: Noon is when he is tallest. Do not sleep in the furrow.

name: The Black Icon
text: Slow Attack. Toughness. It strikes last. The first point of any blow is refused. A saint painted so dark the gold barely shows. It does not hurry. It arrives after you have spent yourself.
quote: Kiss it and your mouth tastes of smoke.

name: Vodyanoy
text: Cryptid. Gills. Toughness. The mill-pond master: frog-mouthed, algae in the beard, a grudge against millers. The first point of any blow is refused.
quote: He drowns what the river was going to spare.

name: Upir of the Chapel
text: Cryptid. Fast Attack. If it survives a battle it struck in, it gains power. The Slavic dead that will not stay under the chapel floor. It strikes first, and a meal makes it heavier.
quote: Stake the rumor. The body already left.

name: The Birch Knot
text: Name a unit. It cannot move or attack on its next rite. A shaman’s knot in a white branch. The named plate stands in the grove and does not get to leave.
quote: Three strips of bark. One name. No road.

name: Icon Smash
text: Name a unit. Deal 3 damage. The mad monk breaks a face. The face was a plate, and the gold leaf cuts.
quote: Even a saint can be used as a stone.

name: Homeward
text: Name a unit and return it to its owner’s hand. The domovoi wants the guest out of the house before the stove cools.
quote: Shoes by the door. You are done here.

name: Stove of the Hut
text: Device. Bank 1 resources and draw 1 card. The hut’s stove pays a coal and deals a plate. Baba’s house is an oath, not a costume.
quote: Sit on the warm side. The cold side belongs to her.

name: The Mad Starets
text: Leader. Once in a sitting: pay 3. Name a unit you own. It gains +3 power. The mad monk nails a black icon to a living chest and calls it armor.
quote: Pray later. First, do not die.

name: Coil Novice
text: The first lamp is lit in a human chest. Cheap, and it still stands after a single blow.
quote: Philosophy begins in wonder.

name: Gyro Rocketeer
text: Fast Attack. When it steps into an enemy, it strikes first. If that blow unmakes them, they deal nothing back.
quote: Give me a place to stand, and I shall move the earth.

name: Trench Revenants
text: Does not conquer. Dead infantry in coil-braced coats. They fight, and they leave the ground unclaimed.
quote: They shall not grow old, as we that are left grow old.

name: Brass Count
text: While this unit stands, your bank yields +1 resources at the start of your rite.
quote: Wealth unused might as well not exist.

name: Charged Fusilier
text: When destroyed, deal 2 damage to every unit in an adjacent tile.
quote: The blast of war blows in our ears.

name: Rune Smith
text: When another unit you control is destroyed, bank +1 resources.
quote: He formed substance out of chaos and made nonexistence into existence.

name: Faustian Coilwright
text: Sacrifice: bank 3 resources. The coilwright's last equation is a receipt.
quote: Two souls, alas, dwell in my breast.

name: Pit Mechanic
text: Sacrifice: deal 3 damage to an adjacent unit. A spanner, then a crater.
quote: Nature, to be commanded, must be obeyed.

name: Hex Banner
text: Once each rite: pay 1. Deal 1 damage to an adjacent unit. The banner keeps the trench in line.
quote: In this sign thou shalt conquer.

name: Blitz Fusilier
text: Pay 1 and sacrifice this unit. Another unit you own gains Fast Attack. The blitz is the gift, not the body.
quote: Speed is the essence of war.
quoted: Sun Tzu, The Art of War

name: Initiate of the Coil
text: Once each rite: pay 2. It gains +1 power. A sworn lamp-bearer, brighter each time it is fed.
quote: As above, so below.

name: Vault Engineer
text: While this unit stands, your bank yields +2 resources at the start of your rite.
quote: Order is Heaven's first law.

name: Night Zeppelin
text: Airship. Does not conquer. It has no ranged strike, and a diagonal is out of reach. It fights only by stepping into an adjacent enemy. Loses 1 power at the start of your rite. You may muster a unit on an empty circle beside it. The envelope crosses the circle and leaves the ground unclaimed.
quote: I am the master of my fate: I am the captain of my soul.

name: Coil Undersider
text: A man who lives in the service tunnels. He closes, and he hits like a rivet gun.
quote: Look within. Within is the fountain of good.

name: Coil Berserk
text: When deployed, discard a random card from your hand. Then it is simply enormous.
quote: Anger is a short madness.

name: Night Aviator
text: Ranged Strike. A shot reaches 2 tiles and is not answered. The shot is a choice. It may instead step into an adjacent enemy, and that blow is an ordinary fight.
quote: No bird soars too high, if he soars with his own wings.

name: Runed Myrmidon
text: At the start of your rite, pay 2 or it cannot act. Plate etched with a working alphabet.
quote: Character is destiny.

name: Champion of the Inner Earth
text: The hollow-earth champion. It costs a fortune and ends arguments.
quote: Know thyself.

name: Amulet of the Coil
text: Device. Sacrifice a unit you own. Deal 3 damage to every unit beside it.
quote: The dose makes the poison.

name: Waking the Sleeper
text: Name a unit and unmake it. Then discard a card. The sleeper wakes hungry.
quote: Arise! Awake! and stop not till the goal is reached.

name: Industrial Rite
text: Sacrifice a unit you own. Bank resources equal to twice its printed cost.
quote: Labor omnia vincit — work conquers all.

name: Chlorine Psalm
text: Gas. Deal 1 damage to every unit on the field. The cloud does not choose.
quote: I am become Death, the destroyer of worlds.

name: Runaway Mint
text: The presses will not stop. Empty both banks. Then draw 1 card.
quote: Wealth consists not in having great possessions, but in having few wants.

name: The Rune Colonel
text: Leader. Once in a sitting: pay 4, unmake a unit you own, and deal 2 to every unit beside it.
quote: To lead the people, walk behind them.

name: The Iron Saint
text: Leader. Once in a sitting: pay 3. A unit gains Fast Attack and may act at once.
quote: The best steel goes through the hottest fire.

name: Ash-Lice
text: A handful of grave-lice in a lead snuffbox. They bite, and they stay.
quote: Little things are infinitely the most important.

name: Parish Tithe-Lord
text: While this unit stands, your bank yields +1 resources at the start of your rite.
quote: In this world nothing can be said to be certain, except death and taxes.

name: Candle Warden
text: Adjacent enemy units cannot move or attack. The candle does the watching.
quote: Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel.

name: Saturn Medium
text: Once each rite: pay 1. Deal 1 damage to an adjacent unit. A mouth full of lead shot.
quote: The dreams are all right enough, but the art of interpreting is lost.

name: Devoted Clerk
text: Stamina. The clerk has four wounds in him before the stamp slips.
quote: Work is love made visible.

name: Cellar Informant
text: Exhaust: score 1 domination. He sells the layout, and the ground pays the fee.
quote: A secret between more than two is no secret.

name: Ancestral Cinder
text: Once in a sitting: pay 1. A unit gains Toughness. A grandfather burned down to a useful coal.
quote: Honor thy father and thy mother: that thy days may be long upon the land.

name: Guided Confessor
text: Toughness. The first point of damage from any strike is refused.
quote: To err is human; to forgive, divine.

name: Strix Widow
text: After this unit strikes and survives, it gains +2 power. When it destroys a unit, you score 2 domination.
quote: Hell hath no fury like a woman scorned.

name: Feral Cantor
text: Exhaust: a unit gains +1 power. The hymn is a laying-on of hands.
quote: Without music, life would be a mistake.

name: Hearth Imp
text: A resource node this imp stands on banks twice.
quote: Keep the fire burning; when the hearth goes cold, the house forgets itself.

name: Unblinking Penitent
text: Untargetable. Does not conquer. Combat and ranged strikes pass over the penitent. When it steps onto an enemy, that enemy returns to its owner's hand.
quote: For the love of God, Montresor!
quoted: Edgar Allan Poe, The Cask of Amontillado

name: Ridden Guard
text: The estate guard, with something older wearing his coat. He closes the distance.
quote: What is bred in the bone will not come out of the flesh.

name: River Bride
text: Does not conquer. She may be mustered, and she leaves the tile's ownership alone.
quote: You cannot step twice into the same river.

name: Hoarfrost Saint
text: Enemy units are deployed exhausted, even those with Fast Attack, while the saint stands.
quote: The frost performs its secret ministry.
quoted: Samuel Taylor Coleridge, Frost at Midnight

name: The Lead Bear
text: Toughness. A parish bear cast in saturnine metal. The first point of any strike is refused.
quote: The bear is wise; he sleeps through the hard season and wakes when the earth is ready.

name: The Birch King
text: The wood that walked into the city. No sermon. Five wounds, five blows.
quote: I think that I shall never see a poem lovely as a tree.

name: Pallid Aurora
text: Deal 1 damage to every unit on the field.
quote: We are all in the gutter, but some of us are looking at the stars.

name: The Sunk Stroke
text: Name a unit. It cannot move or attack on its next rite.
quote: Sitting quietly, doing nothing, spring comes, and the grass grows by itself.

name: Mind-Mildew
text: Name a unit. It cannot move or attack on its next rite.
quote: Reality, n. The dream of a mad philosopher.

name: Lapse of Nerve
text: Move an exhausted unit onto an empty adjacent circle that is not a stronghold.
quote: Courage is resistance to fear, mastery of fear — not absence of fear.

name: Birch Doll
text: Device. Name a unit. It gains +1 power and Toughness. Draw 1 card.
quote: Out of small acorns grow mighty oaks.

name: Leaden Egg
text: Device. Draw 2 cards and bank 2 resources.
quote: Patience is a bitter plant, but it has sweet fruit.

name: The Leaden Stare
text: Leader. Once in a sitting: pay 2. A unit you own gains +3 power.
quote: The eye, which is called the window of the soul.

name: The Birch Crone
text: Leader. Once in a sitting: pay 3 and slide an exhausted unit onto an empty adjacent circle that is not a stronghold.
quote: When an elder dies, a library burns.

name: Alley Inquiry
text: A detective who took the wrong green shortcut. One blow. One wound.
quote: Existence, n. A transient, horrible, fantastic dream, wherein is nothing yet all things do seem.

name: Thorn Sprig
text: If it survives a battle, it gains 1 power. At the end of its own rite, if it is still standing, it gains 1 power. A cutting that learned to walk. It grows only if you keep it.
quote: That which does not kill us makes us stronger.

name: Heath Tithe-Maid
text: While this unit stands, your bank yields +1 resources at the start of your rite.
quote: Whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.

name: Thieving Pollen
text: Once in a sitting: exhaust and deal 1 damage to a unit with power 2 or greater. Jewel-winged thieves.
quote: The bee is little among such as fly; but her fruit is the chief of sweet things.

name: Pollen Orator
text: Once in a sitting: a unit gains +1 power. The speech is a spore that sticks.
quote: Speech is silver, silence is golden.

name: Lion Initiate
text: When this unit conquers a tile, it gains +1 power. Green fire in both fists.
quote: Fortune favors the bold.

name: Sotted Greenhand
text: Stamina. Drunk on sap, and it takes four wounds to put him in the hedge.
quote: In vino veritas — in wine, there is truth.

name: The Grazing Seven
text: When it moves, every adjacent tile the enemy owns becomes neutral. Strongholds are spared. It claims only the square it stands on. Seven pale goats eat a claim down to dirt.
quote: Nature does nothing in vain.

name: Hedgerow Driver
text: When this unit conquers a tile, bank +1 resources.
quote: Nature does not hurry, yet everything is accomplished.

name: Orchard Landlord
text: When this unit conquers a tile, you score 1 domination. He owns the rows between the gaslights. The deed is already in his pocket.
quote: He that planteth a tree is a servant of God.

name: Heath Maiden
text: Once each rite: pay 2. A unit gains +1 power. She crowns them by name.
quote: The earth laughs in flowers.

name: Bog Charger
text: A black horse that is not a horse, bridled in wet gold. It closes, hard.
quote: The wind of heaven is that which blows between a horse's ears.

name: Briar Party
text: When deployed, this unit gains +1 power for each other unit you already control.
quote: Among thorns grow the roses.

name: Green Wail
text: Once each rite: pay 4. Every unit on an adjacent circle is destroyed. The scream is a door.
quote: The land is our mother; when she cries, her children should listen.

name: Cursed Verdant
text: When she conquers a tile, she gains +1 power. A duchess who married the hedge, and the ground feeds her.
quote: Nature, red in tooth and claw.

name: Peat Brute
text: Five wounds. Five blows. The bog made a man and then regretted the size.
quote: What the bog takes, the bog keeps.

name: The Green Kiss
text: Name a unit. It gains +2 power.
quote: One is nearer God's heart in a garden than anywhere else on earth.

name: Opened Barrow
text: Bank 2 resources. A door in the mound pays its toll in coin, not in land.
quote: Speak not against the dead; they have no answer but silence.

name: Lion's Vigil
text: Every unit you control gains +1 power.
quote: The lion does not turn around when small dogs bark.

name: Return to Loam
text: Name a unit and unmake it. Its owner banks resources equal to that unit's printed cost.
quote: Dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return.

name: Lion's Mask
text: Name a unit. It is healed to full, loses its abilities, and its power becomes 4.
quote: We wear the mask that grins and lies, it hides our cheeks and shades our eyes.
quoted: Paul Laurence Dunbar, We Wear the Mask

name: Cup of the Lion
text: Name a unit. It gains +1 power. Draw 1 card.
quote: Drink! for you know not whence you came, nor why.

name: False Vintage
text: Name a unit. It is healed to full, loses its abilities, and its power becomes 1.
quote: Appearances are often deceiving.

name: The Green Sovereign
text: Leader. Once in a sitting: pay 2. A unit gains +1 power, and you draw a card.
quote: The forest is the poor man's overcoat.

name: Queen of the Hedgerow
text: Leader. Once in a sitting: pay 4 and claim an empty circle that is not a stronghold.
quote: A queen among thorns is still a queen.

name: Gutter Theorist
text: A beggar with a correct equation. One stab, then he is gone.
quote: I think, therefore I am.

name: Ruined Patron
text: When deployed, the opponent loses 2 resources.
quote: Cynic, n. A blackguard whose faulty vision sees things as they are, not as they ought to be.

name: Duke of the Crucible
text: While this unit stands, your bank yields +1 resources at the start of your rite.
quote: Separate the earth from the fire, the subtle from the gross, gently and with great ingenuity.

name: Glass Homunculus
text: Slow muster. It cannot move or attack the rite it arrives. A little man grown in a retort.
quote: Man is a microcosm of the universe.

name: Street Magus
text: Once each rite: return a unit you own to your hand. Cups, balls, and one real exit.
quote: Whatever you can do, or dream you can, begin it. Boldness has genius, power and magic in it.

name: Mirror Solvent
text: Once in a sitting: pay 2. It gains the power of an enemy unit. The face was never its own.
quote: Don't part with your illusions. When they are gone you may still exist, but you have ceased to live.

name: Athanor Adept
text: Exhaust: draw 1 card. The adept keeps the furnace fed, and the furnace answers with a page.
quote: Solve et coagula.

name: Athanor Guard
text: Slow muster. It cannot act the rite it arrives. While this unit stands, your bank yields +1.
quote: Festina lente — make haste slowly.

name: Serpent Adept
text: When deployed, the opponent discards a random card.
quote: Be ye therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.

name: Third-Eye Disciple
text: When this unit attacks, the defender is returned to its owner's hand instead of being struck.
quote: The eye with which I see God is the same eye with which God sees me.

name: Azoth Twin
text: Once in a sitting: pay 2. It gains the power of the named unit. A second body poured from the same flask.
quote: Two souls, alas, dwell within my breast.

name: Sealed Assassin
text: Once in a sitting: deal 1 damage to a unit. The seal comes off once.
quote: Silence is a friend who will never betray.

name: Back-Alley Vitriol
text: Acid in a perfume bottle. Three wounds either way.
quote: Visit the interior of the earth, and by rectifying you will find the hidden stone.

name: Jeweled Homage
text: When an enemy unit is destroyed, draw 1 card. An idol that perspires gold when the other side falls.
quote: A thing of beauty is a joy for ever.

name: Quicksilver Valet
text: A servant poured, not born. Four and four, and no small talk.
quote: Mercury is spirit, sulphur is soul, and salt is body.

name: The Open Retort
text: A unit that meets it in combat is destroyed. That unit's owner discards a card. The glass is thinner than it looks.
quote: Nothing is so firmly believed as that which is least known.

name: Lead Golem
text: Slow muster. Six blows, six wounds, and it cannot act the rite it is poured onto the field.
quote: From the first matter all forms arise.

name: Cranial Engine
text: Device. Bank 1 resources and draw 1 card.
quote: The mind is everything. What you think, you become.

name: Lamp of the Work
text: Device. Draw 3 cards.
quote: Knowledge is a light which God casts into the heart.

name: Trepan Rite
text: Name a unit. Deal 1 damage. If it survives, it gains +2 power.
quote: Ghost, n. The outward and visible sign of an inward fear.

name: The Thirteenth Chair
text: Name a unit and return it to its owner's hand.
quote: When the dead speak, the living should listen.

name: Rose of the Shut Garden
text: Device. Take up to 5 resources from the opponent's bank.
quote: A garden enclosed is my sister, my spouse; a spring shut up, a fountain sealed.

name: Carve the Seal
text: Name a unit. It gains +2 power and cannot move or attack on its next rite. The seal is cut, and the feet forget the hour.
quote: Set me as a seal upon thine heart, as a seal upon thine arm.

name: The Mute Alchemist
text: Leader. Once in a sitting: pay 4 and return a unit to its owner's hand.
quote: Silence is the language of God; all else is poor translation.

name: The Gold Fraud
text: Leader. Once in a sitting: pay 2 and draw 2 cards.
quote: All that glisters is not gold.
quoted: William Shakespeare, The Merchant of Venice

name: Velvet Revenant
text: Fast Attack. She strikes before the answering blade. If the other figure falls, it never touches her.
quote: The boundaries which divide Life from Death are at best shadowy and vague.
quoted: Edgar Allan Poe, The Premature Burial

name: Speakeasy Shade
text: Ranged Strike. A shot from the back booth reaches 2 tiles and takes no counterblow.
quote: It is always darkest just before the day dawneth.

name: Alley Medium
text: While this unit stands, your bank yields +1 resources. She reads the till, not the future.
quote: The spirits of the dead hallow a house, for me.

name: Tommy Wight
text: Both strike together. A drum magazine and a dead man's grin. He does not land the first blow.
quote: He who fights with monsters should look to it that he himself does not become a monster.

name: Bone Consigliere
text: He advises with a syringe of green light. Power 3, and he does not sit down.
quote: No man is wise enough by himself.

name: Concrete Angel
text: Toughness. Wings of rebar. Found 9/11/1923 at the site that would become the World Trade Center — nobody knows who created it. The first point of any strike is refused.
quote: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.

name: Grave Capo
text: Cigar, TNT, and a funeral that has not happened yet. He closes.
quote: From a proud tower in the town, Death looks gigantically down.
quoted: Edgar Allan Poe, The City in the Sea

name: Midnight Don
text: Ranged Strike. The don does not stand up. The order travels 2 tiles and is not answered.
quote: Uneasy lies the head that wears a crown.

name: Last Call
text: Name a unit. Deal 3 damage. The bar is closed.
quote: Quoth the Raven, "Nevermore."

name: The Black Handshake
text: Name a unit. It gains +2 power.
quote: A man's word is his bond.

name: Funeral March
text: Deal 1 damage to every unit. The brass section is a dirge.
quote: Man that is born of a woman is of few days, and full of trouble.

name: Lead Violin
text: Device. Draw 2 cards. The case is heavier than a violin.
quote: Music is a higher revelation than all wisdom and philosophy.

name: Cement Shoes
text: Device. Name a unit. It cannot move or attack on its next rite.
quote: The mills of God grind slowly, yet they grind exceeding small.

name: The Widowed Saint
text: Leader. Once in a sitting: pay 2. A unit you own stands back up and gains +1 power.
quote: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.

name: The Laughing Coroner
text: Leader. Once in a sitting: pay 3. Return the top card of your discard to your hand, then draw 1.
quote: Death smiles at us all; all we can do is smile back.

name: Hydesville Rapper
text: A Fox sister's knock in a dark farmhouse. One rap, and she stays for the answer.
quote: Knock, and it shall be opened unto you.

name: Franklin's Key
text: While this unit stands, your bank yields +1 resources. The key still draws the storm into the jar.
quote: Well done is better than well said.

name: Papa John
text: While Papa John is on the field, your powder rites hit harder (Goofer Dust deals 4; Hot-Foot Powder also deals 1).
quote: Only possess that root, and he can be summoned at any time.
quoted: Zora Neale Hurston, High John de Conquer

name: Appleseed Walker
text: A resource node this walker stands on banks twice. He sows, and the ground pays double.
quote: He who plants a tree plants a hope.

name: Coyote's Laugh
text: When deployed, the opponent discards a random card. The trick is the arrival.
quote: Coyote was going along — and wherever Coyote goes, trouble follows laughing.

name: Menlo Spirit-Wright
text: When another unit you control is destroyed, bank +1 resources. The spirit phone rings for the dead.
quote: I am the ghost of the Cardiff Giant. I can have no rest, no peace, till they have given that poor body burial again.

name: Lily Dale Voice
text: When this unit conquers a tile, bank +1 resources. The camp medium makes the ground pay for the sitting.
quote: We are spirits clad in veils; Man by man was never seen.

name: Randolph Glass
text: Untargetable. Does not conquer. Combat and ranged strikes pass over the glass. When it steps onto an enemy, that enemy returns to its owner's hand.
quote: All that we see or seem is but a dream within a dream.

name: Powwow Doctor
text: Toughness. A Lakota medicine chief who carries the old cures. The first point of any strike is refused.
quote: Of course it was not I who cured. It was the power from the outer world, and the visions and ceremonies had only made me like a hole through which the power could come to the two-leggeds.

name: Wardenclyffe Adept
text: Ranged Strike. The tower's arc reaches 2 tiles and takes no counterblow.
quote: If you want to find the secrets of the universe, think in terms of energy, frequency and vibration.

name: Rocket Chemist
text: Fast Attack. He lands the blow before the reply. If they are unmade, they deal nothing.
quote: Imagination is more important than knowledge.

name: Poughkeepsie Seer
text: Andrew Jackson Davis's heir in a lecture hall. He sees the blow coming and answers it at full power.
quote: The pure and simple truth is rarely pure and never simple.

name: The Bell Witch
text: Adjacent enemy units cannot move or attack. The Tennessee haunting sits on the tile and will not let them leave.
quote: But who prays for Satan? Who, in eighteen centuries, has had the common humanity to pray for the one sinner that needed it most?

name: Sleepy Hollow Rider
text: After this unit strikes and survives, it gains +2 power. The Hessian does not need a head to swing.
quote: The apparition of a figure on horseback without a head.
quoted: Washington Irving, The Legend of Sleepy Hollow

name: Leeds Devil
text: Ranged Strike. A shot reaches 2 tiles and is not answered. It does not have to shoot. Stepping into an adjacent enemy is an ordinary fight.
quote: Birth, n. The first and direst of all disasters.

name: Thunderbird
text: Ranged Strike. A storm spirit of the plains and woodlands. The lightning reaches 2 tiles and is not answered in kind.
quote: The Thunder Beings speak in lightning; the earth answers in rain.

name: John Henry
text: He races the steam drill and does not lose. Five blows, five wounds.
quote: A man's a man for a' that.

name: Goofer Dust
text: Name a unit. Deal 3 damage. Graveyard dirt, spoken over the tile.
quote: Grave, n. A place in which the dead are laid to await the coming of the medical student.

name: Hot-Foot Powder
text: Name a unit. It cannot move or attack on its next rite. The powder will not let the feet decide.
quote: You sprinkled hot foot powder all around your daddy's door.
quoted: Robert Johnson, Hellhound on My Trail

name: Liberty Lightning
text: Deal 1 damage to every unit on the field. The key in the jar was only the rehearsal.
quote: Those who would give up essential Liberty, to purchase a little temporary Safety, deserve neither.

name: The Hydesville Knock
text: Draw 2 cards and bank 1 resources. Three knocks means yes.
quote: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find.

name: Spirit Phone
text: Device. Draw 3 cards. Menlo Park keeps a line open to the other side.
quote: I do not fear death. I had been dead for billions and billions of years before I was born, and had not suffered the slightest inconvenience from it.

name: Mojo Hand
text: Device. Name a unit. It gains +2 power. A flannel bag, a root, and a prayer that works.
quote: A mojo is a prayer you can carry.

name: Edgar Cayce
text: Leader of the Columbia Lodge. Once in a sitting: pay 2 and draw 2 cards. The sleeping prophet names what the rite still hides.
quote: Mind is the builder.

name: Edgar Allan Poe
text: Leader. Once in a sitting: pay 3 and return any unit to its owner's hand. Nevermore.
quote: Quoth the Raven, "Nevermore."

name: Mothman
text: Cryptid. Ranged Strike. The red eyes over the river reach 2 tiles and are not answered.
quote: When omens gather, the wise prepare.

name: Sasquatch
text: Cryptid. Toughness. The wild man of the firs. The first wound does not count.
quote: Walk lightly in the forest; you are never alone.

name: Vril Wyrm
text: Cryptid. Toughness. A coil-lit serpent come up from the inner earth.
quote: The dragon is not slain by fear, but by courage that looks it in the eye.

name: Foo Fighter
text: Cryptid. Fast Attack. A ball of weld-light. It strikes first.
quote: The sun is new each day.

name: Black Shuck
text: Cryptid. Fast Attack. The churchyard hound strikes before the bell can answer.
quote: The dog is a gentleman; I hope to go to his heaven, not man's.

name: Lead Toad
text: Cryptid. Tithe +1. The toad that sweats the stone feeds the bank while it stands.
quote: Ugly is only skin deep; the toad may hold a gem.

name: Green Man
text: Cryptid. Tithe +1. The face in the oak. Where he stands, the rite grows richer.
quote: And this our life, exempt from public haunt, finds tongues in trees, books in the running brooks.
quoted: William Shakespeare, As You Like It

name: Afanc
text: Cryptid. Toughness. The lake-beast of the drowned hall. The first wound does not count.
quote: Still waters run deep.

name: Spring-Heeled Jack
text: Cryptid. Fast Attack. He clears the roof and lands the blow before theirs.
quote: The fear of death follows from the fear of life. A man who lives fully is prepared to die at any time.

name: Mirror Hag
text: Cryptid. Untargetable. Does not conquer. Combat and ranged strikes pass over her. If she steps onto an enemy, that enemy returns to hand.
quote: All that we see or seem is but a dream within a dream.
quoted: Edgar Allan Poe, A Dream Within a Dream

name: Grave Ape
text: Cryptid. After it strikes and lives, it gains +2 power. The thing that walks the potter's field.
quote: Death is a dignitary who when he comes announced is to be received with formal manifestations of respect, even by those most familiar with him.
quoted: Ambrose Bierce, An Occurrence at Owl Creek Bridge

name: Pale Passenger
text: Cryptid. Fast Attack. A fare that never pays, and strikes first.
quote: One must pay Charon his fare to cross the Styx.

name: Seth Kern
text: Ranged Strike. Arrest. Chief of police of a southern Mississippi town. His shot reaches 2 tiles. A unit he wounds is arrested and cannot move for its next two turns.
quote: Taxes are what we pay for civilized society.

name: Justin Kern
text: Master of alchemy, esoterism, occultism, the supernatural, philosophy, science & the paranormal. If that is not impressive enough — he has a thermonuclear device. Once in a sitting: The gadget answers — every unit on the field is unmade.
quote: What we understand about modern physics collapses into a realm of ghost & shadows on the quantum level... you are but children with a loaded gun.
quoted: Justin Kern, Life As I See It, 2029

name: South Haven Dispatch
text: Every unit you control gains +5 power. The South Haven siren answers.
quote: All units — occult disturbance. Sirens up. Something older than the precinct is on the line.

name: Radiation Poisoning
text: Gas. Lingering poison blankets the field. At the start of the next turn, every unit takes 3 damage.
quote: Matter remembers the fire that unmade it. What follows is only the Geiger hymn, soft until it is not.
quoted: Attributed to Fulcanelli, on the ash of the Great Work

name: Nuclear Winter
text: Nuclear winter. Neither player banks Resources for one turn.
quote: When the sun fails the ledger, every temple counts the same cold zero. Ash is the only honest coin.
quoted: Attributed to a winter hermit of the Lead Dawn

name: Black Monday
text: The ticker opens and does not close clean. Bank 2 resources.
quote: The sense of responsibility in the financial community for the community as a whole is not small. It is nearly nil.
quoted: John Kenneth Galbraith, The Great Crash 1929
